prompts.vera: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE character emotion sheet for a dark fitness app: exact 3 columns x 2 rows, 3:2 landscape, six equal square cells, no gutters or borders. Original character: female coach 30, sharp discerning eyes, short practical pale blond bob, dark navy high-collar athletic uniform with subtle teal trim; composed discipline, angular graceful nose and sturdy jaw. Art direction: crisp modern 2D anime animation key art, Korean fantasy action anime aesthetic, excellent confident clean line art, appealing strong character silhouettes, simple flat color shapes with precisely two or three cel shadow tones, expressive clearly drawn eyes. NOT 3D, NOT realistic painted skin, NOT gritty comic crosshatching, NOT wrinkles everywhere, NOT fashion advert pretty glossy model, NOT gaunt or depressed. Smooth graphic illustration with dark navy background and subtle colored rim light. All six frames identical head position, hair, outfit, face design, camera straight on and bust crop, face large centered with complete hair and margin above. TOP LEFT neutral attentive closed mouth, TOP MIDDLE concentration narrowed focused eyes, TOP RIGHT confident encouraging smile, BOTTOM LEFT happy warm visibly smiling pride (clear difference from neutral), BOTTOM MIDDLE empathetic concerned soft eyebrows but not sad, BOTTOM RIGHT restful calm softly relaxed eyes. Expressions visibly different in eyebrows, eyelids and mouth, same identity. Keep full hair inside each square. No text, labels, logos, props, weapons, jewelry. Production-ready consistent anime character sheet.
